description: KNa₄Cl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.90 Å) and two longer (3.04 Å) K-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one KCl₆ octahedra, corners with five NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.90 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.97 Å. There are five inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to one K and five Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClKNa₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent K and two Na atoms to form ClK₄Na₂ octahedra that share corners with six ClNa₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ClKNa₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. The Cl-Na bond length is 2.97 Å. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form ClNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six ClK₄Na₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ClKNa₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent K and two equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₄Na₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cl-K bond lengths are 2.90 Å. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. There are a spread of Cl-Na bond distances ranging from 2.76-2.90 Å.
